content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Bargarh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.oav.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 04-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OAV Bargarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the OAV Bargarh TGT and Support Staff posts is 04 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by OAV Bargarh?
faq.answer: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Bargarh has announced a total of 5 vacancies for TGT and Support Staff positions. However, the detailed vacancy breakdown shows 9 posts each for TGT (Principal), Clerk-cum-Accountant, Peon, and Watchman, totaling 36 posts.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. For TGT (Principal), a B.A / B.Sc. is required. For Clerk-cum-Accountant, HSC is the minimum qualification. For Peon and Watchman, the qualification is not explicitly mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between a minimum of 19 years and a maximum of 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the TGT and Support Staff positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 2,000/- to Rs. 19,294/- per month, depending on the specific post. TGT (Principal) receives the highest salary at Rs. 19,294/-.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the OAV Bargarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for OAV Bargarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the TGT and Support Staff posts will involve Document Verification and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section below. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Bargarh?
faq.answer: The official website of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Bargarh is www.oav.edu.in. You can visit this site for more information and to download the application form.
